properties.notes: Demolition of all structures associated with the petrol filling station and redevelopment of the site to provide a residential-led, mixed use development, comprising the retention and refurbishment of Vintage house and development of ground plus 24 storeys in the form of two towers, linked at ground to fifth floor, and consisting of retail/restaurant use (Use Class A1/A3), office (Use Class B1) and 166 residential units.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
